legsA:leg-press.coach: Empty sled again: 10 on every set last time, so go for 12, then add the first plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Same 20 kg on the cable: the first set of 6 held it back, so aim for 10 on all three.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Same 20 kg seated: 10 on every set, so go for 12.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Same 10 kg, slow: 8 last time, aim for 12, and stop if the knee spot hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Same 20 kg: 10 on both sets, so go for 12.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight again: 10 on both sets, so go for 12.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: start with the empty bar or a light Smith or machine, aim for 10, and add weight only if 10 feels easy.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: 10 kg dumbbells: 15 kg gave only 5 on Monday and this day asks 8 to 12, so go for 12.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: 3 kg gave 25 on both sets.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips leaning forward for 8 to 12; under 8, use the chest press machine at a weight for 10.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: pick about 15 kg on the rope, lighter than your 25 kg pushdown, and aim for 12.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg with no pin: 12 a side last time and this day asks 15 to 20, so go for 15.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time on this line: use the 37.5 kg that gave 8 on Pull A and aim for 10.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: your cable row gave 12 at 20 kg, so start near 25 kg and aim for 10.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell for 10 to 12 a side, about 12.5 kg, and start with the left arm.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: a light rope weight, about 10 kg, for 15 to 20; stop if the shoulder hurts.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg with no pin: 12 a side last time, so go for 15.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells a little heavier than your 5 kg curl, about 7.5 kg, for 10 to 15.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: bodyweight or light dumbbells, start with the left leg, and stop if the knee spot hurts.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: start light, aim for 12 with a pause at the top, then add weight next time.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Same 20 kg seated: 10 on every set, so go for 12.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight for 15 to 20, slow, with a pause at the bottom.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: straight legs if you can reach 10, bent knees if not.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: 15 kg again for 6 or more; if it gives 5 again, use 12.5 kg on every set.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Same 10 kg: 8 on every set, so go for 10, then 12.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg with no pin: 12 a side last time, so go for 13 to 15.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Same 30 kg: the second set gave 8, so aim for 12 on both.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Same 25 kg: 10 on every set, so go for 12.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: 3 kg gave 25 on both sets.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Same 37.5 kg: 8 on every set, so go for 10, then step up.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Up one step to 25 kg: all three sets reached 12.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Same 20 kg: 14 on every set, one rep from the step, so go for 15.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Same 10 kg: 12 on every set and no shoulder pain, so go for 14.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg with no pin: 12 a side last time, so go for 14.

pullA:curl.coach: Same 5 kg: 10 on every set, so go for 12, then step up.
